description: This file defines the ManageReviewMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It is responsible for configuring menu items related to performance review management within the OrangeHRM system, specifically overriding the screen 'searchPerformanceReview'.

classes.name: ManageReviewMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the menu for performance review management by overriding specific screens within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default screen for the current module to 'searchPerformanceReview' and returns null.
